ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the recent surge in Medicaid fraud cases and the measures being taken to prevent it
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud?
How can Medicaid fraud be prevented?
ideas.insight: Medicaid fraud is a complex issue that requires a thorough investigation. By following the money and examining the systems in place, we can uncover the root causes of the problem and suggest solutions.
